proposal.observation: Round 1 was accepted (0.6967 -> 0.7187) with the gain coming entirely from correspondence_f1@15 (0.453 -> 0.492); sam_fill_rate (0.7294) and depth_nan_ratio (0.2093) were unchanged to three decimals and denoise_retained_ratio barely moved (0.7425 -> 0.7446), so the denoising/enhancing moves were effectively neutral and the depth-map NaN bands (service tube, arched fittings) are structural rather than gate-driven. After-images: detected_lines.png shows a few extra short oblique fragments (near x~1800/y~780, x~1600/y~3520, x~1500/y~3720, x~1700/y~50) but the oblique yield is still low and blue horizontal fallback segments still dominate every joint column; initial_prompt_points.png is identical to the before-image: 10 centres, only 4 from true oblique intersections (3 positive, 1 negative), 4 'midpoint' fallbacks and 2 'assume' extrapolations, with irregular spacing (y ~870, 1350, 1600, 2850, 3350, 3580). segmentation_results.png keeps all 10 rings (ring_count_error 0) and the K/B1/A1-A4/B2 sequence, with a few thin dark unlabeled bars on ring boundaries.
proposal.rule: d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered) still fires -> f_missing_lines; d8 (m_spacing_regularity poor vs K/AB pattern; centres irregularly spaced and padded with 'assume' points) -> f_pattern_mismatch; chain f_pattern_mismatch -> stage_5 f_crop_offset is the remaining lever on correspondence_f1@15. d5/d6 upstream preconditions were addressed in round 1 with no measurable effect, so stage-3/2 are held fixed and the remediation is r_relax_hough (further) plus r_fix_height_priors (pattern_tolerance), keeping the SAM template that produced the round-1 gain.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines with stage_4_detection.f_pattern_mismatch (residual after round 1); downstream stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset
proposal.rationale: Stage-1 remains locked, so unfolding is untouched. Because round 1's denoising and enhancing changes produced no change in depth_nan_ratio or fill rate, they are carried forward unchanged (mask_r 3.60/3.85, curvature_threshold 0.0004) to avoid re-opening the g007 over-gate risk, and the round-2 move is concentrated on the stage that still shows the diagnosed symptom. Detecting: push oblique Hough to the permissive end of the bounds (threshold 25, maxLineGap 80) so the fragmented oblique traces visible in detected_lines.png merge into full-length segments; lower binary_threshold to 110 so fainter joint pixels survive binarisation (the analogies used 113-127 without spurious-line problems at this family's line density); raise hough_threshold_horizontal to 65 so horizontal fallback contributes fewer competing intersections; raise pattern_tolerance to 14 so the K/AB distance check accepts more of the real oblique intersections instead of discarding them and back-filling with 'assume' centres; keep hough_threshold_vertical at 4300 since the 12 vertical joints already bracket the 10 rings correctly. SAM: retain the round-1 template direction that lifted correspondence, nudging toward the improving analogy s021 (angle 11.8) and toward s028's wider/taller template (segment_width 1900, K_height 1140) which was the only analogy where sam_fill_rate rose; both remain inside bounds. This is a joint overlay; the expected outcome is a further correspondence_f1@15 gain with fill rate and NaN ratio held, and no per-parameter causal effect is claimed.
